005package org.wpilib.math.filter;
006
007import org.wpilib.math.util.MathSharedStore;
008
009/**
010 * A class that limits the rate of change of an input value. Useful for implementing voltage,
011 * setpoint, and/or output ramps. A slew-rate limit is most appropriate when the quantity being
012 * controlled is a velocity or a voltage; when controlling a position, consider using a {@link
013 * org.wpilib.math.trajectory.TrapezoidProfile} instead.
014 */
015public class SlewRateLimiter {
016  private double m_positiveRateLimit;
017  private double m_negativeRateLimit;
018  private double m_prevVal;
019  private double m_prevTime;
020
021  /**
022   * Creates a new SlewRateLimiter with the given positive and negative rate limits and initial
023   * value.
024   *
025   * @param positiveRateLimit The rate-of-change limit in the positive direction, in units per
026   *     second. This is expected to be positive.
027   * @param negativeRateLimit The rate-of-change limit in the negative direction, in units per
028   *     second. This is expected to be negative.
029   * @param initialValue The initial value of the input.
030   */
031  public SlewRateLimiter(double positiveRateLimit, double negativeRateLimit, double initialValue) {
032    m_positiveRateLimit = positiveRateLimit;
033    m_negativeRateLimit = negativeRateLimit;
034    m_prevVal = initialValue;
035    m_prevTime = MathSharedStore.getTimestamp();
036  }
037
038  /**
039   * Creates a new SlewRateLimiter with the given positive rate limit and negative rate limit of
040   * -rateLimit.
041   *
042   * @param rateLimit The rate-of-change limit, in units per second.
043   */
044  public SlewRateLimiter(double rateLimit) {
045    this(rateLimit, -rateLimit, 0);
046  }
047
048  /**
049   * Filters the input to limit its slew rate.
050   *
051   * @param input The input value whose slew rate is to be limited.
052   * @return The filtered value, which will not change faster than the slew rate.
053   */
054  public double calculate(double input) {
055    double currentTime = MathSharedStore.getTimestamp();
056    double elapsedTime = currentTime - m_prevTime;
057    m_prevVal +=
058        Math.clamp(
059            input - m_prevVal,
060            m_negativeRateLimit * elapsedTime,
061            m_positiveRateLimit * elapsedTime);
062    m_prevTime = currentTime;
063    return m_prevVal;
064  }
065
066  /**
067   * Returns the value last calculated by the SlewRateLimiter.
068   *
069   * @return The last value.
070   */
071  public double lastValue() {
072    return m_prevVal;
073  }
074
075  /**
076   * Resets the slew rate limiter to the specified value; ignores the rate limit when doing so.
077   *
078   * @param value The value to reset to.
079   */
080  public void reset(double value) {
081    m_prevVal = value;
082    m_prevTime = MathSharedStore.getTimestamp();
083  }
084
085  /**
086   * Sets the rate-of-change limit to the given positive and negative rate limits.
087   *
088   * @param positiveRateLimit The rate-of-change limit in the positive direction, in units per
089   *     second. This is expected to be positive.
090   * @param negativeRateLimit The rate-of-change limit in the negative direction, in units per
091   *     second. This is expected to be negative.
092   */
093  public void setLimit(double positiveRateLimit, double negativeRateLimit) {
094    m_positiveRateLimit = positiveRateLimit;
095    m_negativeRateLimit = negativeRateLimit;
096  }
097
098  /**
099   * Sets the rate-of-change limit to the given positive rate limit and negative rate limit of
100   * -rateLimit.
101   *
102   * @param rateLimit The rate-of-change limit in both directions, in units per second. This is
103   *     expected to be positive.
104   */
105  public void setLimit(double rateLimit) {
106    m_positiveRateLimit = rateLimit;
107    m_negativeRateLimit = -rateLimit;
108  }
109}
